title: syzygium nigricans subsp. phaeophyllum
intro: Syzygium nigricans subsp. phaeophyllum, commonly known as the Mountain Apple or Cider Apple, is a plant species belonging to the family Myrtaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Syzygium nigricans subsp. phaeophyllum include its ability to act as an anti-hypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
